To make the Juju woodcutting potions without fully understanding all of the complexities of Herblore Habitat, follow this guide.
Requires 80 Farming, 77 Hunter, 71 Herblore, and either 65 Construction or 65,000 coins.
The goal is to obtain samaden seeds and oily vines from amphibious jadinkos for the potion.
• Bring around 1,000 coins to Herblore habitat, plus 65,000 coins if players do not have 65 construction or know someone with 65. This can be assisted and the payment avoided.
• From Papa Mambo located in the northern section of the area, purchase a blue vine blossom flower seed and 3-4 marasamaw plant traps.
• Plant the Blue vine blossom in the flower patch located in the centre section of the area. This will cause common jadinkos to spawn in the northern area.
• Trap common jadinkos with the Marasamaw plant traps until players have obtained Samaden seeds and Lergberry seeds.
• As these drops are random players may have to trap more than 500 of them, be prepared.
• Alternatively, if players wish to earn points or have some saved up in the Jadinko Lair downstairs, players can exchange them for seeds at the offering stone and get the seeds that way.
• Once obtained.
• Plant the Samaden seed in the herb patch. There is a second herb patch is available to the east by crossing the large vine hanging over the water.
• Plant the Lergberry seed in the bush patch. Players will find it useful to ensure the bush does not die, so use super compost and keep an eye on its health while players are there.
• Construct a pond in the construction spot.
• This will cause Amphibious jadinkos to spawn in the northern area. Trap these with the marasamaw plant traps. Each one captured gives the player 1 Oily vine.…

To make the juju woodcutting potions and by skipping the use of all of the complexities of Herblore Habitat, follow this guide.
Requires 80 Farming, 87 Hunter and 71 Herblore.
The goal is to obtain samaden seeds and oily vines from amphibious jadinkos for the potion.
• Head to Herblore Habitat and buy a Samaden seed from Papa Mambo and also grab 5 marasamaw plant traps, and plant the samaden seed in the herb patch.
• Head to Anachronia, south from the base camp, and follow the path up to the far north-east.
• Here players will find the amphibious jadinkos which the players can proceed to trap with the marasamaw plant traps.
The samaden herbs will grow in the normal amount of herb growth time (~70 minutes).
Once grown, players can make juju woodcutting potions. This method is faster than the previous one, but also has a higher Hunter requirement.
sc: It is made by using an oily vine on a samaden potion (unfinished), requiring 71 Herblore, yielding a juju woodcutting potion (3) and 160 Herblore experience.
Any additional logs produced by other boosts such as the Seer's headband or Perfect juju woodcutting potions will also be banked at the same time.
